items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had a band with Wayne Shorter, Albert Dailey, and Cecil McBee.

ctx.x: The civil rights movement and the war.
Not that. That was a wild period. I had some good bands in the ’60s. I had bands with Wayne at Slugs. Did you say Slugs a minute ago? Did I hear Slugs?
